items.title: ‘The agency just can’t achieve what is required’: The cyclospora outbreak came after the FDA conducted nearly 35% less foreign food inspections
items.summary: The agency has failed to hit its congressionally mandated targets for international inspections before COVID-19, and recent staffing cuts could mean even fewer inspections.
items.titleZh: “该机构根本无法达到要求”：环孢菌爆发是在美国食品药品监督管理局对外国食品的检查减少了近35%之后
items.summaryZh: 该机构未能在新冠肺炎之前实现国会规定的国际检查目标，最近的人员裁减可能意味着更少的检查。
